connector.name: kdbx
connector.registryDescription: Read-only access to secrets in a local KeePassXC vault. Runs commands with them injected.
connector.summary: Runs locally from the container image kdbx:0.2.1. No credential is declared, and it reaches 8 of 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published from the yarrasys account, and the linked repository sits under the same account. Namespace ownership was proven at publish time.
